findings.title: Unusual Daily Revenue Detected
findings.claim: Daily revenue on 2026-05-30 was 11809.10 SAR, 3.58 standard deviations from baseline mean of 6658.52 SAR.
coverage_notes: Baseline computed from 28 daily observations across 4 trailing weeks (2026-04-27 to 2026-05-25)
assumptions: Z-score threshold of 2.0 (95% confidence under normal distribution)
Refunds included in net revenue calculation
No exclusion of known invalid periods in analysis window

coverage_notes: Baseline computed from 28 daily observations across 4 trailing weeks (2026-04-27 to 2026-05-25)
assumptions: Z-score threshold of 2.0 (95% confidence under normal distribution)
Transaction count derived from unique transaction_id per day

findings.title: Unusual Daily Traffic Count Detected
findings.claim: Daily foot traffic on 2026-05-29 was 1954 visitors, 4.30 standard deviations from baseline mean of 794.1 visitors.
coverage_notes: Baseline computed from 28 daily observations across 4 trailing weeks (2026-04-27 to 2026-05-25)
assumptions: Z-score threshold of 2.0 (95% confidence under normal distribution)
Traffic count aggregated from hourly door_count readings
Dead sensor days excluded from both baseline and analysis
